meta.note: Average monthly rent near each university. US: mean of HUD FY2026 1-bedroom Fair Market Rents (county, and the residential ZIP next to campus) and the Zillow Observed Rent Index for the city. Elsewhere: mean of published one-bedroom rents (official statistics first). Each figure links to its source.
